data.text:
Lokendra Singh S/O Shri Shivdayal Singh vs State Of Rajasthan 
(2024:Rj-Jp:10575) on 29 February, 2024
Author: Anil Kumar Upman Bench: Anil Kumar Upman [2024:RJ-JP:10575]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 2164/2023 Lokendra Singh S/o Shri Shivdayal Singh, R/o Har Manegar Ryagi Industries Rico Area Dholpur Rajasthan. 
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Public Prosecutor. 
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mayank Gupta For Respondent(s) : Mr. Babulal Nasuna, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR UPMAN Order 29/02/2024 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on 03.05.2022, factory of the petitioner was seized by the police in presence of food safety officer and samples were collected. On the basis of this fact, impugned FIR No.159/2022 was registered at Police Station Sadar Dholpur, District Dholpur for the offences under Sections 272, 273 & 420 of IPC and Sections 26(2)(i) & 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It is further submitted that after thorough investigation, charge-sheet was submitted for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 & 420 of IPC and Sections 26(2)(i) & 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the learned trial court has taken cognizance for the said offences. It is further submitted that prosecution cannot be launched on the basis of police report. In support of his contentions, learned counsel has placed reliance upon the judgment passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in matter of [2024:RJ-JP:10575] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2164/2023] Ram Nath Vs.
State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors. in Criminal Appeal No.472/2012. 
In view of above, issue notice to the respondents. Learned State counsel accepts notice on behalf of respondent-State. Copy of this petition has already been supplied in his office. 
Learned State counsel is directed to file reply to this petition. List this case on 04.04.2024. 
Meanwhile, further proceedings pending before the trial court arising out of FIR No.159/2022 registered at Police Station Sadar Dholpur, District Dholpur shall remain stayed. 
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J CHARU SONI /311 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
